Our sign will be a fire on Maebong hill.

lines.rookie: A small flame goes up on Maebong hill.
lines.junior: A small flame goes up on Maebong hill.
lines.master: Then a small flame goes up on Maebong hill.

lines.rookie: On far hills, more lights.
lines.junior: On far hills, more lights come on.
lines.master: On far hills, more lights answer.

lines.rookie: First the night of the sign, then the day of the march.
lines.junior: First the night of the sign, then the day of the march.
lines.master: First the night of the sign, and then the day of the march.

lines.rookie: March has thirty-one days. The night before April 1 is the last night of March.
lines.junior: March has thirty-one days. So the night before April 1 is the last night of March.
lines.master: March has thirty-one days. So the night before April 1 is the very last night of March.

lines.rookie: The march is on the first of April, not the second.
lines.junior: The march is on the first of April, not the second.
lines.master: The march is on the first of April, not on the second.

lines.rookie: That is Mr. Pyo's day. Two messengers said the first of April.
lines.junior: That is Mr. Pyo's day. Two messengers said the first of April.
lines.master: That is Mr. Pyo's wrong day. Two messengers said the first of April.

lines.rookie: Wrong order. The night of the sign is first.
lines.junior: Wrong order. The night of the sign comes first.
lines.master: The numbers are right, but the order is wrong. The night of the sign comes first.

lines.rookie: That night, Gwan-sun lights the hill fire.
lines.junior: That night, Gwan-sun lights the fire on the hill.
lines.master: That night, Gwan-sun lights the fire on Maebong hill.

lines.rookie: 1 April 1919. Thousands meet at Aunae Market.
lines.junior: 1 April 1919. Thousands of people meet at Aunae Market.
lines.master: 1 April 1919. Thousands of people gather at Aunae Market.

lines.rookie: Gwan-sun helps lead them. They call for independence.
lines.junior: Gwan-sun helps lead them. They call for independence.
lines.master: Gwan-sun helps the village elders lead them. Together they call for independence.

lines.rookie: 1 March 1919: the March First Movement. Korea called for independence.
lines.junior: 1 March 1919: the March First Movement. All Korea called for independence.
lines.master: 1 March 1919: the March First Movement. People across Korea called for independence.

lines.rookie: The stranger waits at the station, on Mr. Pyo's wrong day. He never reads the plan.
lines.junior: The stranger waits at the station, on Mr. Pyo's wrong day. He never reads the plan.
lines.master: The stranger waits at the station, on Mr. Pyo's wrong day. He never even reads the plan.

lines.rookie: No name, just a flame. The plan stayed safe.
lines.junior: No name, just a small flame. The plan stayed safe.
lines.master: No name, only a small flame. And the plan stayed safe.

lines.rookie: Sunja
lines.junior: Sunja
lines.master: Sunja

lines.rookie: Gwan-sun
lines.junior: Gwan-sun
lines.master: Gwan-sun

lines.rookie: Okhui
lines.junior: Okhui
lines.master: Okhui

lines.rookie: Sunja writes only in Hangeul too. But her mark is a flower, not a flame.
lines.junior: Sunja writes only in Hangeul too, but her mark is a flower, not a flame.
lines.master: Sunja also writes only in Hangeul, but her mark is a flower, not a flame.

lines.rookie: Gwan-sun asked you. Her notebook is not here.
lines.junior: Gwan-sun asked you. Her notebook is not on the table.
lines.master: Gwan-sun asked you to find the writer. Her notebook is not even on the table.

lines.rookie: Okhui writes in Chinese characters. Her mark is stars.
lines.junior: Okhui writes in Chinese characters. Her mark is stars.
lines.master: Okhui writes in Chinese characters. Her mark is stars, not a flame.
